digest.component_or_area: LLM framework public surfaces / CLI / MCP
propositions: Remove three deprecated single-pass review public entry points: CLI verb 'rebar review', library function rebar.llm.review_ticket, and MCP tool review_ticket, approved for removal in pre-1.0 breaking pass #3

The internal engine _review_ticket_impl and review_result.schema.json must remain; the schema wiring key must be re-pointed from 'review_ticket' to 'review_code' to keep the schema from becoming orphaned
Delete three _scheduled deprecation rows and the explanatory block comment from src/rebar/_deprecations.py, then append the removal to the historical NOTE for removed scheduled surfaces
Generated CLI and MCP reference docs must be regenerated via scripts (gen_cli_reference.py, gen_mcp_reference.py) and server.json's REBAR_MCP_ALLOW_LLM description must be resynced
Remove 19 test file references to the deprecated surfaces; delete test_cli_review_alias.py wholesale and retarget remaining tests to review-plan/engine paths
Update hand-written docs (llm-framework.md, architecture.md, README.md, etc.) to remove mentions of the three removed surfaces while preserving ADRs and eval corpus as historical record
